planets.name: TOI-426 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-426 with a 1.32-day year, found in 2026.

text.card: TOI-426 b was found in 2026 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 2 planets known around TOI-426. Its orbit and size follow Castro-González et al. 2026's fit, the archive's default.
